verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no advertised approval or success rate on Ellis Porter's pages, and so no stated basis such as case counts, time window, or methodology. Its warning against 'guaranteed approval' and its conditional refund offer are related transparency signals, not a substantiated success-rate disclosure, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
